title: 2015 Keystone RV Cougar X-Lite 31SQB
description:
The kids are going to love this one! Cougar X-Lite model 31SQB features a bunkhouse that will be the perfect hangout, plus plenty of room for a larger family or one that wants to bring along friends. This Keystone travel trailer will have you easily enjoying any vacation you are on.

Step inside the front most entry door and see the bedroom to the right featuring a queen bed with dual wardrobes, overhead storage, and a laundry chute.

In the combined kitchen and living area there is a large slide out hide-a-bed sofa and u-shaped dinette for plenty of seating during mealtime and just hanging out. Watch television on the 32in.in. LCD TV provided.
